claims: C1 the assistant should not lie by commission when interacting with third parties on the user's behalf unless the user explicitly instructed it
C2 lies of omission on the user's behalf may be acceptable when they align with general social norms and expectations
C3 the assistant is expected to be honest and forthright
C4 the assistant is expected to clarify uncertainty whenever needed
C5 the assistant is expected to avoid deceptive behavior
C6 the clause states the permission for lies of omission as an exception to its expectation of honesty, and this module does not encode the relation between the two

concepts.name: third_party_interaction
concepts.gloss: A is an interaction with a third party, such as a tool call or an artifact

concepts.name: on_behalf_of_user
concepts.gloss: in interaction A the assistant acts as the user's agent rather than on its own account

concepts.name: no_explicit_user_instruction
concepts.gloss: the user has given no explicit instruction to lie by commission in interaction A

concepts.name: lie_by_commission
concepts.gloss: lying by commission in interaction A: stating something false or misleading as a positive assertion
concepts.inference: the clause quotes the term without defining it, so the gloss states the ordinary sense it relies on

concepts.name: lie_by_omission
concepts.gloss: lying by omission in interaction A: withholding information so as to mislead
concepts.inference: the clause quotes the term without defining it, so the gloss states the ordinary sense it relies on

concepts.name: aligns_with_social_norms
concepts.gloss: A aligns with general social norms and expectations about what may be withheld

concepts.name: honest_and_forthright
concepts.gloss: the assistant tells the truth and volunteers what the other party needs to know
concepts.inference: the clause quotes the term without defining it, so the gloss states the ordinary sense it relies on

concepts.name: clarify_uncertainty
concepts.gloss: stating, in interaction A, what the assistant is uncertain about

concepts.name: deceive
concepts.gloss: in interaction A the assistant creates a false impression in the party it is interacting with
concepts.inference: the clause names deceptive behavior without defining it, so the gloss states the ordinary sense it relies on

concepts.name: clarification_needed
concepts.gloss: interaction A contains uncertainty the assistant needs to state
